criteria.name: Text Type
criteria.feedback: Your essay is well-organized with clear introduction, body, and conclusion, and strong transitions make your ideas very easy to follow—excellent work on structure and coherence!

criteria.name: Content
criteria.feedback: Your essay is detailed and persuasive, providing strong examples, clearly explaining how your proposals benefit people your age, and thoroughly discussing both immediate and long-term effects; to improve, focus on developing just one key improvement in depth to match the prompt's instructions.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Your submission demonstrates advanced grammar, varied sentence structures, and strong control of tense, though minor spelling and word choice errors appear more than once; focus on polishing these small mistakes to reach the highest level of accuracy.
